answer.text: Make a significant investment and participate in the management process to improve operational efficiency or benefit from a material corporate event

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 251-252 of the workbook, an activist strategy involves making a significant investment in a company and participating in the management process, seeking to improve operational efficiency or to benefit from a material corporate event. The Trap: Passive buying, indefinite short-selling and benchmark-matching strategies do not involve active engagement with the investee company's management. Note: Activist investing is an event-driven sub-strategy and depends on the manager's ability to engage constructively with investee companies.
